definitions.full: H6440. panim or paneh [ מָּנֶה ], plural מָּנִים 2123 noun masculine Prov 25:23 and (Ezekiel = 21:21 = edge ; on 2Sam 10:9 see below) feminine face , also faces (as turned toward one); — plural absolute מָּנִים Gen 32:31 +; construct מְּנֵי 2Sam 14:32 +; suffix 1 singular מָּנַי Gen 43:3 +; 3 masculine singular מָּנָיו 4:5 +, מָּנֵי֑מוֺ Psa 11:7 (Kö ll.1.446 ); 2 masculine plural מְּנֵיכֶם Gen 40:7 +, etc.; — usually with verb plural, 4:5-6 , Exod 33:14 +; with verb singular Lam 4:16 (through influence of intervening ׳י , Ges § 146a ), Prov 15:14 (but read מִּי , as Qr, see מֶּה ); — I. 1. face, faces ( Jer 30:6 ; Ezek 27:35 +, compare 1:6 ; 10:14 , 21 etc.): a. literally, of man Gen 43:31 ; 2Sam 19:5 ; 1Kin 19:13 ; Lev 13:14 ; Dan 8:18 ; 10:9 , 15 +; פ ׳עוֺר Exod 35:29-30 , 35 ; pale (from alarm) Isa 29:22 ; Jer 30:6 , flushed Isa 13:8 ; Ezek 21:3 , compare Nahum 2:11 ; Joel 2:6 ; tearful Isa 25:8 ; Job 16:16 ; sad, ׳פ רעים Gen 40:7 , compare Neh 2:2-3 , also פ ׳רֹעַ Eccl 7:8 i.e. sadness; פ ׳יֵּיטִב Prov 15:13 maketh glad the face ; פָנֶיךָ נָָֽפְלוּ , Gen 4:5-6 , why is the face fallen (in displeasure), compare 1Sam 1:18 (reading לוּ נָָֽפְ נָָֽפְלָה, , or הִמִּילָה ); covered with shame Ezek 7:18 , whence figurative of confusion, discomfiture Jer 51:51 ; Psa 69:8 ; 83:17 , etc. b. of ׳י Exod 33:20 , compare 33:23 . c. אֶלמָּֿנִים מָּנִים face to face, of seeing (God) Gen 32:31 , compare Judg 6:22 , knowing Deut 34:10 , judging Ezek 20:35 , speaking Exod 33:11 , and so ׳פ ׳בְּפ Deut 5:4 ; פָנִים נִתְרֶאֶה 2Kin 14:8 see each other (in the) face = meet each other in battle, compare 14:11 2Chr 25:17 , 21 . d. of relations with פ ׳הֵרִים ׳׃י Ezra 9:6 , in worship (see also נשׂא ); in spiritual sense Jer 2:27 ; 32:33 ( פָנִים וְלֹא עֹרֶף אֵלַי מָּנָה ); פ ׳נָתַן י ׳לִדְרוֺשׁ 2Chr 20:3 ; אֶלאֲֿדֹנָי אֶתפֿ ׳נָתַן Dan 9:3 ; פָנִים קְשֵׁי הַבָּנִים Ezek 2:4 . e. of ׳י himself, מִכֶּם מָּנִיםִ יָסִיר לֹא 2Chr 30:9 ; רָ֑ע י ׳מְּנֵי בְּעֹשֵׂי Psa 34:17 ; מָּנֶיךָ גַּעֲרַת 80:17 . — See further below 7. 2. a. = presence, person , of ׳י Exod 33:14-15 , בְּפָנָיו Deut 4:37 , מָּנָיו מַלְאַךְ Isa 63:9 ; הַמָּנִים לֶחֶם , see לֶחֶם ; of ׳י s angry presence Lam 4:16 ; Psa 21:10 ; of Absalom 2Sam 17:11 ; in weakened sense, nearly = suffix (compare נפשׁ 4a ), Prov 7:15 . b. with ראה technically, see one's face , i.e. appear before one, in one's presence: before a man Gen 32:21 (+ 3 other uses of ׳פ ), (God, with יראה pointed as Niph`al , see II 2 ); especially as privilege, = have access to, man of rank Gen 43:3 , 5 ; 44:23 , 26 , king Exod 10:28 (twice in verse) compare 10:29 (all J), 2Sam 14:24 (twice in verse); 14:28 , 32 ; compare 3:13 (twice in verse); הַמֶּלֶךְ פְנֵי רֹאֵי 2Kin 25:19 = Jer 52:25 ; Est 1:14 ; implying favour of person seen, man Gen 33:10 (J), God 33:10 , compare Job 33:26 (Hiph`il), and, with חזה , Psa 11:7 ; 17:15 . 3 face of seraphim Isa 6:2 , cherubim Exod 25:20 (twice in verse) = 37:9 (twice in verse), Ezek 1:8 , 11 ; 2Chr 3:13 +. 4 face of animals, הַצּאֹן מְּנֵי Gen 30:40 ; ופ ׳שׁוֺר נֶשֶׁר ׳פ וּפ ׳אַרְיֵה Ezek 1:10 (in descr. of cherubim), compare 10:14 ; ׳פ אַרְיֵה also 1Chr 12:8 (figurative), כְֿפִיר׳פ Ezek 41:19 ; פ ׳מִּתְחֵי Job 41:6 of crocodile. 5 face (= surface) of ground ( הָאֲדָמָה ) Gen 2:6 ; 4:14 ; 7:4 ; Psa 104:30 +, so ׳פ הָאָרֶץ Gen 1:29 ; 7:3 ; 8:9 ; 11:4 , 8 , 9 ; 19:28 ; Isa 24:1 , ׳פ תֵבֵל 14:21 ; 27:6 ; of a field Prov 24:31 ; ׳פ תְהוֺם Gen 1:2 (twice in verse); Job 38:30 , ׳פ הַמַּיִם Gen 7:18 ; הַשָּׁמַיִם׳פ רְקִיעַ 1:20 ; כִֿסֵּה׳פ Job 26:9 i.e. of God's throne (but Bu reads כֶּסֶה fullmoon ); ׳פ הַלּוֺט Job 25:7 see [ לוּט ; ׳פ לְבוּשׁוֺ 41:5 the expanse of his [the crocodile's] coat; front (especially Ezek.), of house Ezek 41:14 ; 47:1 , ׳פ הַקֹּדֶשׁ 41:21 ; of gate 40:6 , 20 , 22 ; 42:15 ; 43:4 ; of chamber 40:44 (twice in verse); 40:45-46 , of pot ( סִיר ) Jer 1:13 ; ׳פ הַמִּלְחָמָה 2Sam 10:9 battle-front = 1Chr 19:10 (verb agrees with ׳הַמּ in Gender, Ges § 146a ); = van of locust-army Joel 2:20 (opposed to סֹפוֺ ); front , i.e. edge , of sword Ezek 21:21 , of axe Eccl 10:10 ; = condition, state of a thing, as denoted by its appearance ; of flock Prov 27:23 ; ׳פ הַדָּבָר 2Sam 14:20 the appearance (situation, attitude) of the affair. 6 as adverb of location וּמֵאָחוֺר מִמָּנִים 2Sam 10:9 before and behind = ׳פ ׳וְֿ 1Chr 19:10 , also Ezek 2:10 ; 2Chr 13:14 ; מְּנֵי toward Cant 7:5, also in front (to the East?) of 20:16 (see לִפְנֵי d below); לְפָנִים forward Jer 7:24 (opposed to לְאחוֺר ); מִלִּפְנִים 1Kin 6:29 see מְּנִימָה ; adverb temporal לְפָנִים formerly Deut 2:12 , 20 ; Josh 11:10 ; Judg 1:10-11 , 13 12 t.; מִלְּפָנִים Isa 41:26 from beforetime (|| מֵראֹשׁ ). 7 for other phrases see: אוֺר verb Hiph`il 5 ; אוֺר n. 10 ; בּוֺשׁ Hiph`il ; בקשׁ Pi`el 3 ; בּשֶׁת 1 ; [ הַכָּרָה ]; הָדַר 2 ; זָעַם Niph`al ; זָעַף 1 ; הָבַשׁ 1a ; I. חָרָה I חָוַר ; חָזַק Pi`el 5 ; II. חלה ; IV. חמר ; חָפָה ; טָחַן ; יָעַד Hoph`al ; יְשׁוּעָה 3 ; כּוּן Hiph`il 3 ; כִּמֶּר 1 ; כָּסָה Pi`el 1, 2 ; מָאוֺר ; מְגַמָּה p. 169; I. מוּל ; מַשּׂא ; [ נָבַט ] Hiph`il 3 ; נֶגֶד 1, 2 c ; נֹכַח ; נָכַר Hiph`il ; נָפַל 3b , and Hiph`il 5 ; נָשָׂא 1b (3); נָתַן 2b ; סָבַב Hiph`il 1 a ; סָתַר Hiph`il 2 ; I. עֵבֶר 2 ; עָזַז עַז, Hiph`il ; עָמַד Hiph`il 6 a ; II. עֻמָּה ; [ צָרַב ]; [ קָדַם ] Pi`el ; שִׂים ; שׁוּב Hiph`il ; שִׁית ; II. שָׁנָה Pi`el ; תֹּפֶת . II. מְּנֵי with prepositions: — 1 אֶלמְּֿנֵי : a. to the presence of , Exod 23:17 pregnantly הָאָדוֺן אֶלמְּֿנֵי ֗֗֗ יֵרָאֶה shall appear (coming) to the presence of (= before) ׳י (|| 34:23 הָא ׳אֶתמְּֿנֵי ); with יָצָא = to confront 2Chr 19:2 . b. to the front of , after a verb of motion, Lev 6:7 אֶלמְּֿנֵ ֗֗֗ אֹתָהּ ׳הַקְרֵב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ , 9:5 ; 16:2 ; Num 17:8 ; 20:10 . c. towards or on the front of ( אֶל = עַל ), Ezek 41:4 , 12 , 15 , 25 ; 42:2-3 , 7 , 10 , 13 ; 45:7 ; 48:21 . d. on to the surface of , Lev 14:53 הַשָּׂדֶה אֶלמְּֿנֵי ֗֗֗ וְשִׁלַּח , Ezek 16:5 . 2 אֶתמְּֿנֵי close by (II. אֵת ) the face or front of: hence a. the presence of , 1Sam 2:11 ׳אֶתפֿ עֵלִי 1Kin 12:6 who stood ׳אֶתפֿ שְׁלֹמֹה (compare לִפְנֵי 10:8 ), Est 1:10 ; Prov 17:24 ; pregnantly (nisi וַיַּנִּחֵם leg., ᵑ7 ᵑ6 We Dr and others) 1Sam 22:4 . Specifically י ׳אֶתמְּֿנֵי Gen 19:13 ( 1Sam 2:17 ), 2:27 ; 2:18 ; and with נִרְאָה of the appearance of all males at the three annual חַגִּים , Exod 34:23 אֶתפֿ כָּלזְֿכוּרְךָ ׳יֵרָאֶה הָאָדֹן , 34:24 ; Deut 16:16 (compare Dr), 31:11 ; 1Sam 1:22 (|| ׳אלפֿ ׳י Exod 23:17 ); so מָּנַי alone 23:15 = 34:20 ( רֵיקָם פָנַי יֵרָאוּ לֹא ), Isa 1:22 , פָנֶיךָ Psa 42:3 (according to many, Ges Thes Di Exod 23:15 Che Isa 1:12 , critical note , the verb in all these passages was originally Qal , afterwards pointed as Niph`al to avoid the expression see the face of ׳י ); אֶתמָּֿנֶיךָ in thy presence Psa 16:10 ; 21:7 ; Psalm 140:14. b. in front of , Gen 33:18 . אֶתפֿ ׳וַיִּחַן הָעִיר , Lev 4:6 י ׳לִפְנֵי ׳אֶתפֿ הַקֹּדֶשׁ פָרֹכֶת 4:17 . — מְּנֵי מֵאֵת from before , see II. אֵת 4a. 3. בִּפְנֵי : (a) in the face of , mostly in particular phrases, with hostile import: thus, with יָרַק to spit Num 12:14 ; Deut 25:9 ; התיצב to make a stand 7:24 ; 11:25 , and עמד Josh 10:8 , בְּפָנֶיךָ אִישׁ יַעֲמֹד לֹא 21:42 ; 23:9 ; עָנָה to answer (give evidence) against , Hosea 5:5 בפניו ישׂראל גאון וענה , 7:10 ; Job 16:8 ; בִּפְנֵיהֶם וְנָקֹטוּ = feel loathing against their own selves, Ezek 6:9 , so 20:43 ; 36:31 . (b) in front of , 42:12 . 4 לִפְנֵי , properly at the face or front of , the most General word for in the presence of, before: as Gen 18:22 אַבְרָהָם לִפְנֵי עֹמֵד , Exod 4:21 ; 11:10 ; 2Sam 2:14 ; Prov 17:18 + often; after a verb of motion, Gen 47:2 פ ׳לפני וַיַּצִּיגֵם and set them before Pharaoh, 27:20 לפני י הִקְרָה ׳כִּי literally made (it) to meet before me (compare 24:12 ), Exod 29:10 ; Prov 18:16 etc. In particular, a. With the implication of ( a ) under the eye or oversight of , Deut 25:2 ; 1Sam 3:1 . ( b ) under the eye and regard of , Gen 17:18 לְפָנֶיךָ יִחְיֶה יִשְׁמָעֵאל לוּ , Hosea 6:2 ; Isa 53:2 ; Psa 61:8 ; compare Jer 30:20 ; 31:36 ; Isa 66:22 ; Psalm 102:29: also 1Sam 2:28 ; 2Sam 19:14 . ( c ) figurative for in (or into ) the full (mental) view of , Gen 6:13 לְפָנַי בָּא כָּלבָּֿשָׂר קֵץ is come in before me , Lam 1:22 לְפָנֶיךָ כָלרָֿעָתָם תָּבאֹ , Jonah 1:2 לְפָנַי עָֽלְתָה (compare אֶל Gen 18:21 ; Exod 2:23 ), Isa 65:6 לְפָנָ֑י כְּתוּבָה , Jer 2:22 לְפָנָי נִכְתָּךְ (compare נֶגְדִּי Isa 47:12 ). ( d ) openly before , 1Sam 12:2 לִפְנֵי הִתְהַלֵךְ , and with collateral idea of deserving (and receiving) regard 2:35 , especially י ׳לפני Gen 17:1 and elsewhere. ( e ) in presence of the moon or sun, Psa 72:5 ; 72:17 , i.e. as long as they endure. ( f ) free before, at the disposal of , Gen 13:9 לְפָנֶיךָ כָלהָֿאָרֶץ הֲלֹא (compare 20:15 ; 34:10 ; 47:6 ; Jer 40:4 ; 2Chr 14:6 ), 2 Chron 24:51; Song 8:12 . ( g ) in the sight (estimation) of , Gen 7:1 thee have I seen to be just before me, 10:9 a mighty hunter before ׳י , Deut 24:4 ל ׳תּוֺעֵבָה ׳י , 24:13 ל ׳צְדָקָה ׳י , 1Sam 20:1 b, ׳ל ׳י אָרוּר Josh 6:26 ; 1Sam 26:19 , ל ׳לְרָצוֺן ׳י acceptable before ׳י , Lev 1:3 +, Psalm 19:15; 2Kin 5:1 a great man אֲדֹנָיו לִפְנֵי , Prov 14:12 ; Psa 143:2 ; ל ׳וַיִּיטַב (late synonym of earlier בְּעֵנֵי ) Neh 2:5-6 , Est 5:14 ; ל ׳טוֺב Eccl 2:26 ; 7:26 ; compare also לִפְנֵי לְרַחֲמִים נָתַן , see רַחֲמִים . ( h ) י ׳לִפְנֵי , specifically of acts done with a solemn sense of ׳י 's presence, often, but not always, at a sanctuary: Gen 27:7 that I may eat and bless thee before ׳י , before I die, Exod 18:12 to eat bread before God, Deut 1:45 ye wept before ׳י , 6:25 ; 12:7 (to eat, so 12:18 ; 14:23 , 26 ; 15:20 ), 15:12 (rejoice, so 15:18 ; 27:7 ; Isa 9:2 ), Josh 18:6 ; 24:1 ; Judg 11:11 ; 20:23 , 26 ; 21:2 ; 1Sam 7:6 ; 10:19 ; 11:15 ; 12:7 ; 15:33 ; 23:18 ; 2Sam 5:3 ; 7:18 ; 21:9 ; and constantly in P, as Exod 16:9 , 33 , 34 ; Lev 1:5 , 11 ; 3:1 , 7 etc.; of residents in Jerusalem Isa 23:18 . So in ל ׳הָלַךְ ׳י 1Kin 2:4 and elsewhere. b. In other phrases: — ( a ) לִפְנֵי עָמַד to stand before , i.e. wait upon, be in attendance on , Deut 1:38 and elsewhere (see עָמַד 1e ). Simil. לִפְנֵי הָיָה 1Sam 19:7 (compare 29:8 ), 2Kin 5:2 ; ל ׳עָבַד 2Sam 16:19 . ( b ) לִפְנֵי הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה to bow down before Gen 23:12 ; Deut 26:10 ; 2Kin 18:22 and elsewhere (see below שָׁחָה ; also נָפַל 3b ): so with הִתְמַּלֵּל to pray 1Sam 1:12 +; compare פָני הלך 1Kin 12:30 ; 1Chr 21:30 . ( c ) to be smitten ( נִגַּף ) before a foe; see נָגַף Niph`al [contrast מִמְּנֵי נוּס : below 6a ]. So with נָפַל 1Sam 14:13 ; נָתַן (in helplessness or flight), especially in Deuteronomy, as Deut 1:8 , 21 ; 7:2 (twice in verse); 7:23 ; Josh 10:12 ; 11:6 + (Dr DT lxxxii ): compare Judg 4:15 ; 2Sam 5:20 ; Isa 45:1 ; Jer 1:17 . ( d ) לִפְנֵי עָמַד to stand (make a stand) before (not quite so strong as ׳ע בִּפְנֵי , above 3 ), Exod 9:11 ; Judg 2:14 ; 2Kin 10:4 ; Jer 49:19 ; Psa 76:8 ; 147:17 ; Nahum 1:6 ; so with הִתְיַצֵּב Deut 9:2 ; Josh 1:5 ; Job 41:2 , קוּם Josh 7:12-13 ,. ( e ) in hostile sense (rare), לִפְנֵי יָצָא go forth to face 1Chr 14:8 ; 2Chr 14:9 . ( f ) לִפְנֵי ( נָתַן ) שִׂים , of food, to set or place before , Gen 18:8 ; 24:33 +. ( g ) לִפְנֵי נָתַן to set before , i.e. propound for acceptance or choice, usually of laws (especially Deuteronomy, Jeremiah), Deut 4:8 ; 11:26 , 32 ; 30:1 , 15 , 19 ; 1Kin 9:6 (D 2 ), Jer 9:12 ; 21:8 ; 26:4 ; 44:10 ; Dan 9:10 , compare Ezek 23:24 (place at disposal of): so with שִׂים Exod 19:7 ; 21:1 . c. With reference to position: ( a ) in front of, before , especially with verbs of motion (with which נֶגֶד is hardly used), Gen 32:21 לְפָנָ֔י הַהֹלֶכֶת בַּמִּנְחָה that goeth before me, 33:14 the cattle לְפָנַי אֲשֶׁר , Exod 17:5 ; 23:20 etc.; in the description of a march or procession, 13:21-22 , Num 10:33 ; Isa 52:12 ; 58:8 +; 2Sam 3:31 and wail before Abner (before his bier); of flocks before a shepherd Gen 32:18 ; of captives or booty driven before a conqueror 1Sam 30:20 (read לְפָנָיו וַיִּנְהֲגוּ We Dr), Isa 8:4 ; 40:10 = 62:11 לְפָנָיו וּפְעֻלָּתוֺ his recompence (i.e. his newly-recovered people, regarded as his prize of war) before him, Amos 9:4 ; Lam 1:5-6 , ( b ) of a leader, etc. = at the head of , Deut 10:11 ; Judg 9:39 ; 1Sam 8:20 ; Micah 1:13 and elsewhere; compare לפני ויצא בא ( העם ) Num 27:17 ; 1Sam 18:13 , 16 ; 2Chr 1:10 ; Eccl 4:16 before whom (at whose head) he was. ( c ) denoting superiority, before, above , Gen 48:20 מנשׁה לפני אתאֿפרים וַיָּשֶׂם , Job 34:19 . d. Of places (not very common): Exod 14:2 before Pi-hahiroth . . ., before Baal-zephon, Num 33:7 b, Gen 23:17 ל ׳אשׁר מַמְרֵא (usually מ פני ׳על : see 7a d ), 1Chr 19:7 ; Neh 8:1 , 3 ; before the temple, veil, altar, etc., Exod 16:34 + ׳ל הָעֵדֻת , 30:6 + ׳ל הַמָּרֹכֶת , 40:5-6 , Num 3:38 ; 7:10 and elsewhere (all P), 1Kin 6:21 ; 7:49 +. e. Of time, before: Amos 1:1 : רעַשׁ הָָֽ לפני before the earthquake, Gen 29:26 ; 30:30 לְפָנַי before me (i.e. before I came to thee), Exod 10:14 כן היה לא לפניו before it there was not the like, Num 13:22 ; 1Kin 16:25 , 30 לְפָנָיו אֲשֶׁר מִכֹּל , Isa 43:10 ; 48:7 ; Prov 8:25 ; Job 15:7 etc. Sq. infinitive, Gen 13:10 י שַׁחֵת ׳לִפְנֵי before ׳י s destroying, etc., 27:7 מוֺתִי לִפְנֵי , 36:31 ; 1Sam 9:15 +. Once, in late Hebrew, מִזֶּה לִפְנֵי before this Neh 13:4 . f.
